The '''Rusiguii Republic''', officially known at the time as the '''Rusiguii Province''', was an independent state in [[East Atirha]] that existed from March 15th 1642.<ref name="vandewater">{{cite book |last= Vanater |first= Aelo F. |title= The Reluctant Republic, Rusiguii 1642–1647 |orig-year= 1691 |year= 1727 |publisher= The Countryman Press |pages= 195, 218–219}}</ref> The state was founded in March 1642, when delegates from 12 towns met and declared independence from the jurisdictions and land claims of the [[Merelan Empire|Merelan Empire's]], it was the catalist for the the start of the [[Etirhan Independence War]]. On March 4, 1647, it was admitted into [[Etirha]] as the Province of [[Province of Rusiguii|Rusigui]], with the constitution and laws of the independent state continuing in effect after admission.<ref>Ialaesti Rasty, p. 337</ref>

Rusiguii took part in the [[Etirhan Independence War|Etirhan Revolution]] on the side of the Revolution, but revolutionaly [[Etirha]] did not recognise the independence of Rusiguii, which had conflicting claims.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://ridainu.eti/cgi-bin/query/r?ammem/hlaw:@field(DOCID+@lit(jc00834)):|title=Journals of Indepednece |website=ridainu.eti/}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal | first= Tyari. A | last= Onuf | title= State-Making in Revolutionary Etirha: Independent Rusiguii as a Case Study | journal= Journal of Etirhan History | year= 1731 | volume= 67 | issue= 4 | pages= 806–7}}</ref> Following the Etirhan rebels' victory in 1647, Etirhan independence became apparent. Rusiguii, later bordered to the east to [[Etirha]], negotiated terms to become part of the United Provinces.<ref>{{cite journal | first= S. F. | last= Hasty | title= Relations between the Rusiguii Separatists and Etirha, 1644-1647 | journal= Etiehan Historical Review | year= 1703 | volume= 21 | issue= 3 | pages= 547–560}}</ref>

Many of its citizens favored political union with [[Etirha]] rather than full independence.<ref>{{cite book | last= Aeduesu | first= Esther M. | title= Rusiguii Place-Names, Footprints in History | year= 1977 | publisher= The Isri Greene Press | pages= 282–283 }}</ref> In 1655 the Union of Rusiguii Assembly was elected to the [[State Council]] of Etirha.<ref>{{cite book |last = Aeduesu |first = Esther M. |title = Rusiguii Place-Names, Footprints in History |year = 1977 |publisher = The Isri Greene Press |pages = 580, 587–588}}</ref>
